stories.headline: Iranian missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia prompt military response threats
stories.summary: Iran launched sustained missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia over three weeks, targeting Riyadh, oil facilities, and infrastructure. Saudi air defenses intercepted hundreds of projectiles. Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan warned Saudi Arabia reserves the right to take military action and said trust with Iran is 'completely shattered.'

stories.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has been privately encouraging US President Donald Trump to continue military strikes against Iran, advising him to 'keep hitting the Iranians hard,' according to multiple reports citing White House officials.

stories.headline: Iranian attacks target Saudi Aramco oil facilities amid regional energy crisis
stories.summary: Iranian missiles and drones struck multiple Saudi Aramco facilities including the Ras Tanura refinery and SAMREF refinery in Yanbu. Saudi Aramco restarted operations at Ras Tanura after a temporary shutdown and implemented emergency protocols amid the energy infrastructure attacks.

stories.summary: King Salman delivered an Eid Al-Fitr message highlighting Saudi Arabia's efforts to support global peace and maintain security and stability amid current regional challenges. He also issued a royal decree establishing Riyadh University of Arts as part of the Kingdom's cultural development initiatives.

stories.summary: Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman conveyed praise from King Salman and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to the Saudi armed forces for their heroic role in defending the Kingdom amid ongoing regional tensions and missile attacks.

stories.headline: NEOM megaproject scales back with tunnel contract cancellations
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia's NEOM project cancelled major construction contracts including a $1 billion tunnel project for The Line. The Kingdom is reportedly scaling back the ambitious megaproject and repositioning it around industrial development and data centers amid rising costs and economic pressures.

stories.summary: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman received Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi in Jeddah to discuss regional developments and Iranian attacks on Gulf states. stories.headline: Saudi Arabia grants US expanded access to King Fahd Air Base amid Iran tensions
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia agreed to give the United States wider access to King Fahd Air Base in Taif for operations against Iran. The decision follows high-level discussions between US officials and Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman as the Kingdom moves closer to supporting US-Israeli military actions.
